subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should the Android long-press message action scope be limited to Copy and Select Copy first, or should Share and Reply ship in the same feature?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue proposes multiple actions and Reply changes user expectations about whether quoted context reaches the model; that scope should be chosen by maintainers before a new implementation path is queued.

options.title: Copy and Select Copy first
options.body: Add the core text-reuse actions now, keep Share and Reply for a later focused decision, and reduce risk around composer/model-context behavior.

options.title: Full action sheet
options.body: Ship Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply together, accepting the larger UI and validation scope in one Android feature.

options.title: Close or narrow the feature
options.body: Decline the broader Android action menu or narrow it to a smaller copy-only affordance if maintainers do not want this surface in core app UX.

recommendation.title: Copy and Select Copy first
recommendation.body: Add the core text-reuse actions now, keep Share and Reply for a later focused decision, and reduce risk around composer/model-context behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and adjacent merged Android chat history point to Peter Steinberger as the best available routing owner for the Android chat UI scope decision.
